summary: Windows WPF app for managing local winget package workflows.
active_objective: No active implementation task; continue residual work from next_tasks in priority order.
assumptions: Audit smoke tests may call winget availability/search but must not install, uninstall, or upgrade packages.
Packaging may create or replace generated files under artifacts only.
GUI manual testing was not performed; UI findings are based on XAML, ViewModels, services, and tests.

Default winget timeout policy is conservative: 2 minutes for show/search/list, 5 minutes for source maintenance, 10 minutes for other commands, and 90 minutes for install/upgrade/uninstall/elevated launches.
Installer lifecycle validation was run in the current elevated Windows environment after confirming no existing OnlyWinget install state.
The current host reports ASUS hardware with a hypervisor present; dedicated VM isolation was not independently attestable from this workspace.
Google Play Games may report a newer winget manifest version while the installed application registration remains on 26.5.27.1 after the installer completes.
decisions: Application behavior was not changed during the audit.
Audit deliverables are kept at the repository root: AUDIT_CRITICO.md, APP_FLOW.md, AUDIT_FINDINGS.json, and AUDIT_ACTION_PLAN.md.
After invalid or unreadable AppsList.json load, the app must create a timestamped recovery backup before replacing the preset library; if backup creation fails, save is blocked.
Imported presets with advanced winget arguments are untrusted by default; --custom and --override are blocked during batch execution until the package row is reviewed and saved in the app.
Batch install/update flows expose user cancellation and pass cancellation tokens into OperationRunner, direct winget process execution, and elevated launch waits.

The package interrogation parser accepts localized winget show headers that preserve the Package Name [Package.Id] shape and handles quoted inline YAML sequences without splitting comma-containing quoted values.
next_tasks: P0-03 Manually verify live cancellation from the WPF UI for direct winget install/update, elevated launch, and update refresh; confirm the UI recovers, logs cancellation, and does not leave actions permanently disabled.
P1-01 Harden package interrogation fetches from microsoft/winget-pkgs with cancellation tokens, short timeout, max response size, one bounded retry, and package/version cache.

P1-02 Replace or further isolate the manual YAML/output parsers with structured parsing or a larger fixture-backed parser suite covering real winget manifests, multiline YAML, localized output beyond IT/EN, and reduced-mode fallback.

P1-03 Add a local application diagnostic log separate from winget logs, with structured event IDs, stack traces for developer diagnostics, and user-facing messages that do not expose secrets or raw exception details.
P2-01 Harden packaging cleanup: port safe path validation from build-gate.ps1 into scripts\package.ps1 before any recursive delete, limiting deletion to known artifacts subdirectories.

P2-02 Review WiX uninstall behavior: validate RemoveFolderEx paths under ProgramFiles\OnlyWinget, document the intended uninstall channel, and decide whether the internal MSI should remain hidden from Apps & Features.
P2-03 Convert disabled winget smoke tests from passed-by-return to explicit skipped/trait-separated behavior, and define when real smoke tests must run for release.
P3-01 Decide whether to migrate xUnit 2.9.3 to xUnit v3 or document a temporary hold with a review date.
P3-02 Decide whether reduced mode may allow silent installations; if not, constrain reduced mode to interactive/default-safe installs and document the behavior.
risks: GUI cancellation was covered by ViewModel tests but not manually exercised in a live WPF session.
Strict release policy may still require rerunning installer lifecycle validation in a known disposable VM snapshot.
The audit identified other runtime failure modes outside the completed cancellation/timeout and parser hardening task.

A real clean-profile Google.PlayGames upgrade was not executed from this workspace because it would mutate the current Windows environment; the behavior is covered by automated ViewModel/runner tests and a non-mutating winget list confirmed 26.5.27.1 -> 149.0.7814.0 is present on this host.
last_completed_work: Completed P0-02: hardened and verified Google.PlayGames update progress handling with byte-based progress parsing, indeterminate installer progress, and deselection when winget still reports the same update.
open_questions: Should reduced mode allow silent installations?
handoff_notes: Data recovery overwrite risk from AUD-003 is mitigated. Imported advanced-argument preset risk from AUD-002 is mitigated for --custom/--override batch execution. Cancellation/timeout and parser hardening are implemented and covered by unit tests. Progress reporting parses winget percentage and byte-count output; installer phases without measurable progress are shown as indeterminate in the WPF progress bar. Update rows are deselected when a completed attempt still appears in the refreshed winget update list. Installer lifecycle validation completed successfully; report: artifacts/installer-validation/Release/installer-lifecycle-report.txt. Official Release build gate passed; report: artifacts/build-report.txt. Execute residual work strictly in next_tasks order unless a higher-priority production issue appears.
